categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in real estate development, including land acquisition, construction, and sale of commercial buildings and residential properties mainly in Kaohsiung and Tainan. It also generates rental income from investment properties and sells specific agricultural land. The focus is on developing quality residential buildings targeting first-time homebuyers and those upgrading homes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on traditional construction methods, purchasing land and contracting reputable domestic construction firms for building projects. It emphasizes cost control, quality management, and brand optimization. There is no R&D expenditure or proprietary technology development as it operates in the construction and real estate sector.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual homebuyers, especially first-time buyers and those seeking to upgrade their homes, mainly in southern Taiwan. The company also serves commercial tenants through property leasing. The market is influenced by government housing policies and local economic developments such as the TSMC semiconductor plant investment.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in southern Taiwan, particularly in Kaohsiung City (districts like Zuoying, Nanzi, Lingya, Fengshan) and Tainan City. The company also holds land assets in New Taipei City and Taoyuan City but focuses development in the south.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, property development, construction management (via subsidiaries), and sales/rental to end customers. It controls construction through its wholly owned construction subsidiary.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include stabilizing project starts to match market demand, focusing on affordable, quality residential products for self-use and home upgrading. The company emphasizes brand building, cost control, customer service enhancement (including app development), and risk management. It has no R&D activities but integrates sustainability and ESG goals into management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of completed residential and commercial buildings and rental income from investment properties. The company also benefits from land sales. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on property development and leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other regional real estate developers in southern Taiwan, especially in Kaohsiung and Tainan. It positions itself as a stable, quality-focused developer targeting the mainstream residential market with emphasis on affordability and brand reputation. It benefits from local industrial growth such as TSMC's investment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported significant growth in 2024 with operating revenue increasing over 300% year-on-year to approximately NT$6.95 billion and net profit more than doubling to NT$2.33 billion. Total assets grew by about 27% to NT$19 billion. The company maintains a stable workforce of around 100 employees and has a strong equity base with ongoing capital increases from convertible bonds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering quality, affordable residential properties tailored to first-time buyers and home upgraders, with careful location selection and design to meet market demand. It focuses on brand building, customer service excellence, and sustainability practices, including green building materials and community engagement, to differentiate itself in a competitive market.
